about.summary: A versatile interior point solver that solves linear programs (LPs), quadratic programs (QPs), second-order cone programs (SOCPs), semidefinite programs (SDPs), and problems with exponential and power cone constraints (<https://clarabel.org/stable/>). For quadratic objectives, unlike interior point solvers based on the standard homogeneous self-dual embedding (HSDE) model, Clarabel handles quadratic objective without requiring any epigraphical reformulation of its objective function. It can therefore be significantly faster than other HSDE-based solvers for problems with quadratic objective functions. Infeasible problems are detected using using a homogeneous embedding technique.

raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.11.3" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-clarabel
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/clarabel_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/clarabel/clarabel_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7e10551cbba54669865d5586e59906c70d0fb252afe2af3d6bd0418d194dedd3
  patches:
    - patches/0001-append-RUSTFLAGS.patch

build:
  number: 0
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/R.dll'        # [win]
    - '*/Rblas.dll'    # [win]
    - '*/Rlapack.dll'  # [win]
  skip: true  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}        # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - r-cli                            # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - {{ compiler('c') }}              # [not win]
    - {{ stdlib('c') }}                # [not win]
    - {{ compiler('m2w64_c') }}        # [win]
    - {{ stdlib('m2w64_c') }}          # [win]
    - {{ compiler('fortran') }}        # [not win]
    - {{ compiler('m2w64_fortran') }}  # [win]
    - {{ compiler('rust') }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - {{ posix }}filesystem            # [win]
    - {{ posix }}sed                   # [win]
    - {{ posix }}grep                  # [win]
    - {{ posix }}autoconf
    - {{ posix }}automake              # [not win]
    - {{ posix }}automake-wrapper      # [win]
    - pkg-config
    - {{ posix }}make
    - {{ posix }}coreutils             # [win]
    - {{ posix }}zip                   # [win]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-cli
    - libblas
    - liblapack
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-cli

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('clarabel')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('clarabel')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://oxfordcontrol.github.io/clarabel-r/
  dev_url: https://github.com/oxfordcontrol/clarabel-r/
  license: Apache-2.0
  summary: A versatile interior point solver that solves linear programs (LPs), quadratic programs (QPs), second-order cone programs (SOCPs), semidefinite programs (SDPs), and problems with exponential and power cone constraints (<https://clarabel.org/stable/>). For quadratic objectives, unlike interior point solvers 
    based on the standard homogeneous self-dual embedding (HSDE) model, Clarabel handles quadratic objective without requiring any epigraphical reformulation of its objective function. It can therefore be significantly faster than other HSDE-based solvers for problems with quadratic objective functions. Infeasible 
    problems are detected using using a homogeneous embedding technique.
  license_family: APACHE
  license_file:
    - LICENSE-2.0.txt
    - THIRDPARTY.yml

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
